remarks: Step into timeless charm with this quintessential Dutch Colonial, gracefully nestled on a breathtaking parcel in one of the most sought-after neighborhoods, Ox Ridge. From the moment you arrive, this property captivates with its classic gabled rooflines, symmetrical facade, and inviting curb appeal. A true nod to the craftsmanship of a bygone era. Inside, the home exudes warmth and character. A cozy brick fireplace welcomes you, perfect for curling up on chilly New England evenings and the sweet screened in porch gives the perfect escape on those breezy summer nights. A formal dining room that practically begs for dinner parties, with its elegant built-in corner cabinets and ample space to gather and celebrate. Upstairs, you'll find four spacious bedrooms, each with plenty of closet space. The true star of this home is the outdoor space. Step outside to discover just under an acre of pure enchantment. The sprawling backyard is a haven of mature trees, lush greenery, and endless possibilities. Imagine summer barbecues on the expansive patio, games of catch on the manicured lawn, or even the addition of a pool or large garden. You'll enjoy the convenience of being close to top-rated schools, boutique shopping, fine dining, and local parks. Whether you're commuting to work or exploring the vibrant community, you'll appreciate the balance of tranquility and accessibility. This isn't just a house, it's a home where memories are made.
